suitableFor: full-width image-only hero banners at the top of a content page
long-form article headers where the title/author appear below the image as default content
notSuitableFor: promo banners with an overlaid heading, description and CTA (use hero-banner)
compact inline text banners with no feature image

distinctFrom.hero: Vanilla local 'hero' is bare boilerplate that only toggles a no-image state class. hero-article keeps that behavior but is styled specifically for a full-width, image-only editorial lead where the article title and author render below the image as default content.
distinctFrom.hero-banner: hero-banner (colorScheme=accent) renders an overlaid/adjacent text panel with heading + description + a single CTA button for homepage promo banners. hero-article is image-ONLY with no overlaid text or CTA — a lead photograph for magazine articles. Similarity to hero-banner scored ~0.65 (< 0.80 threshold), so a new variant was created rather than reusing hero-banner.
